verdict.rationale: Gecko scans pull requests and posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab. It applies a configurable fail-on severity threshold and separates findings the PR introduces from pre-existing ones, so new findings can block a PR (gecko-security-docs-5, -28, -29). It does this through a hosted App status check, not a CI runner step. Scans can be triggered from a pipeline via the API with a dedicated CI/CD key (gecko-security-docs-10, -25), but nothing documents a CLI or exit-code behavior that would fail a CI job. missing for 10: CLI or CI-runner integration that returns non-zero exit codes on new findings, documented pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI job), independent hands-on corroboration of PR gating.
